modules.title: 不同工作应该放在什么时候

items.title: 首次创建时做初始化
items.text: onLoad 可以读取初始参数，onReady 表示首次视图已准备好。它们都不代表异步数据已经请求完成。

items.title: 再次显示时处理可能过期的内容
items.text: 同一个页面的 onShow 可以触发多次。需要时在这里刷新；onHide 可以暂停工作，onUnload 可以清理这个页面持有的资源。

modules.title: 每次显示都要刷新吗
modules.text: 本例限定在普通 navigateTo 与 navigateBack。其他跳转方式和标签页可能不同；也不应每次 onShow 都重复请求所有数据，要按内容是否可能过期来决定。

lessonPractice.title: 预约详情已修改，navigateBack 返回原列表，但刷新只写在 onLoad 中。应检查哪个时机？

options.label: 列表 onShow 时刷新可能变化的预约
options.feedback: 列表实例保留着，返回只是再次显示，不会重新触发 onLoad。

options.label: 把列表刷新移到 onReady 中执行
options.feedback: onReady 对应首次视图准备好，这次返回不会再触发。

options.label: 等列表 onUnload 时再读取新预约
options.feedback: 列表没有卸载；卸载适合清理，不是返回可见列表的时机。

en.title: Booking details were updated. navigateBack shows the existing list, but refresh currently runs only in onLoad. What should be checked?

options.label: Refresh the changed booking when list.onShow runs
options.feedback: The list instance was kept, so returning shows it without another onLoad.

options.label: Put the refresh in list.onReady instead
options.feedback: onReady belongs to initial rendering and does not run on this return.

options.label: Wait for list.onUnload before refreshing
options.feedback: The list was not unloaded; unloading is cleanup timing, not returning to the visible list.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 可以这样发给项目里的 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 预约详情修改后，返回列表仍是旧时间。请检查页面生命周期：列表是否只在 onLoad 读取数据，返回时 onShow 是否需要刷新。改完连续进入详情、修改、返回两次，确认列表显示最新预约，也没有重复请求。

en.title: Send this to the AI Agent in your project
en.text: After editing booking details, the list still shows the old time on return. Check the page lifecycle: is data loaded only in onLoad, and should onShow refresh it? Repeat entering details, editing, and returning twice; verify the latest booking appears without duplicate requests.

items.title: Initialize once for this instance
items.text: onLoad handles initial parameters; onReady indicates the initial view is ready. Neither callback means a data request has completed.

items.title: Respond when the page reappears
items.text: onShow can run multiple times on the same instance. Refresh data that may have changed; onHide can pause work and onUnload can clean up resources.

modules.title: Should every request run again on each appearance?
modules.text: This example uses ordinary navigateTo and navigateBack. Other navigation and tab operations may differ. Do not reload every request on every onShow; decide which data may be stale and prevent duplicate work.

distinctions.label: Click event
distinctions.text: Triggered by the user pressing a particular control. Lifecycle callbacks come from page transitions.

distinctions.label: Application lifecycle
distinctions.text: Describes the app as a whole. Each page has its own instance and lifecycle.
